seoTitle: How to Save Your Progress in Jotform Easily
metaDescription: Learn how Jotform's auto-save, Save and Continue Later, and revision history features work in 2026 to protect your form-building and submission progress.
intro: Losing form-building progress or a respondent's half-finished submission is frustrating, and Jotform has a few built-in safeguards worth understanding. This guide covers the platform's real-time auto-save, enabling Save and Continue Later for respondents, and using revision history to recover an earlier version of your form.

steps.heading: Understand cloud auto-save
steps.body: The Form Builder canvas actively auto-saves your work as you build, protecting against accidental data loss while editing.

steps.heading: Enable Save and Continue Later
steps.body: Go to the Settings tab and locate the Save and Continue Later toggle, then activate it so respondents can save incomplete drafts.

steps.heading: Customize the draft experience
steps.body: Adjust the draft notification email template and save-button alert layout so respondents know how to resume their form.

steps.heading: Use revision history
steps.body: Open the revision history panel to view and restore a previous saved state of your form if you need to undo recent changes.

steps.heading: Download a manual backup
steps.body: Export and download your form's template configuration as a local backup, and check the incomplete submissions dashboard inside Jotform Tables.

faq.question: Do I need to manually save my form while building it?
faq.answer: No, the Form Builder canvas uses real-time cloud auto-saving, so your edits are protected without needing a manual save button.

faq.question: Can respondents come back later to finish a form?
faq.answer: Yes, once you enable Save and Continue Later in your settings, respondents can save an incomplete draft and return to finish it.

faq.question: How do I recover an earlier version of my form?
faq.answer: Open the revision history panel, which lets you view and restore past saved states of your form canvas.

faq.question: Where can I see incomplete submissions from respondents?
faq.answer: Incomplete submissions appear in a dedicated dashboard inside Jotform Tables, separate from fully completed entries.
